description: This file contains functions and types for interacting with Microsoft Teams messages via Graph API, including retrieving, pinning, unpinning, reacting, and searching messages.

methods.name: stripTargetPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'conversation:' or 'user:' prefix from a raw string to get the raw ID.

methods.name: resolveGraphConversationId
methods.description: Resolves a user or conversation ID to a Graph-compatible chat or team ID, including lookup in conversation store for user IDs.

methods.name: resolveConversationPath
methods.description: Constructs API path components based on whether the target is a chat or channel.

methods.name: getMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Fetches a specific message by ID from a chat or channel.

methods.name: pinMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Pins a message in a chat or channel via Graph API.

methods.name: unpinMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Unpins a message in a chat or channel via Graph API.

methods.name: listPinsMSTeams
methods.description: Lists all pinned messages in a chat or channel.

methods.name: validateReactionType
methods.description: Validates and normalizes reaction type string.

methods.name: reactMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Adds a reaction to a message.

methods.name: unreactMessageMSTeams
methods.description: Removes a reaction from a message.

methods.name: listReactionsMSTeams
methods.description: Lists reactions on a message, grouped by type.

methods.name: searchMessagesMSTeams
methods.description: Searches messages in a chat or channel by content.
